body: As I watch the car disappear, I feel my heart rate quicken and my mind whirl with thoughts of danger. My eyes dart back to the office building, scanning for any sign of the car, its occupant, or any suspicious activity. The sudden vacuum of their absence creates a gaping hole in my routine, and I'm momentarily lost in thoughts of what could have happened.
